description: Existing use of property as a Class C4 HMO (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for an Existing Use)
decision_conditions: The existing use does not require planning permission by reason of Section(s) 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990: Section 191 as amended by section 10 of the Planning Compensation Act 1991, as the Applicant has been able to demonstrate that on the balance of probabilities, the operation described as the Description of the Development has been in existence, prior to the adoption of the Article 4 Direction on 11/12/2025
It should be noted that if the property (subject of this application) is used as a HMO and occupied by more than 6 persons, planning permission will be required.
